data.narrative:
Radical AI is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $55M to date. The leadership team includes CEO Joseph F. Krause (former Army Research Lab neuromorphic semiconductor researcher and AlleyCorp deep-tech investor), President Jorge Colindres (ex-AlleyCorp), and Chief Science Officer Prof. Gerbrand Ceder (UC Berkeley materials science, 25 years as MIT R.P. Simmons Professor). The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (277810.KQ), though peer-level multiples could not be reliably established due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables in robotics and manufacturing.

The stage-progression method is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using the $55M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progressions yields $138M. This method is grounded in observed capital step patterns for frontier-tech companies at this maturity level but reflects limited direct peer anchoring.

The valuation analysis supports a range of $117M (low) to $158M (high), with a median estimate of $138M. Key uncertainties include the absence of sufficiently narrow peer comparables—peer-median triangulation was not feasible given only one same-stage comparable in the robotics sector. The reliance on a single method underscores that this range should be treated as a directional estimate pending revenue traction or closer comps at the next funding stage.
